<div class="paper-title">MP43 (HS-20): Focal Hockeystick Case</div>

::: {.status-note}
**Status:** focal case in the current analysis; not formally recommended or
adopted. MP29 (HS+20) is retained as its annual-limit sensitivity case.
:::

## Identity and controls

| Component | Current 500-draw definition |
|---|---|
| Analysis code and label | `tun43`; MP43; HS-20 |
| Stock/index indicator | `cpues.ind`; mean of the five standardized indices |
| Reference and recent windows | 2019--2023 reference; 3-year recent average |
| Harvest control rule | Hockey-stick (`hockeystick.hcr`) |
| Minimum and target catch | 270 and 2,000 kt |
| Limit and refined trigger | 0.1 and 1.9375 |
| Annual decrease/increase limits | -20% / +15% (`dlow = 0.80`, `dupp = 1.15`) |
| Initial simulated catch | 1,385 kt |

## Rule

Let $I_t$ be the combined recent index. Before the annual change limit, the
catch recommendation is

$$
C_t^* =
\begin{cases}
270, & I_t \le 0.1,\\
270 + (I_t-0.1)\dfrac{2000-270}{1.9375-0.1}, & 0.1 < I_t < 1.9375,\\
2000, & I_t \ge 1.9375.
\end{cases}
$$

The annual constraint then limits advice to 80%--115% of the previous advice.

## What the current analysis shows

MP43 was refined from the earlier 100-draw control using the same 500
posterior draws and tuning years (2041--2050) as the other seven CMPs. Its
realized mean dynamic Kobe-green probability was 0.5918 against the 0.60
objective. The completed reference and nine-OM robustness results are included
in the SC14 report and current Slick file.

Operational units, annual cutoffs, missing-data and rounding rules, and the
formal exceptional-circumstances protocol still require approval before use.
